title: Traffic and daylight on the Meridiana
description: Cars, taxis and buses drive the avenue's lanes, queue at red lights, keep out of a blocked junction and go on green, while the traffic lights and walk signals change with them; the bike lane in the median carries cyclists both ways, who brake for Gerard. Then the outdoor daylight (a near-white sun with a cool sky fill) on Passatge Maresme in the morning.

steps.caption: The median's bike lane: cyclists ride it both ways, each on its own half, and brake for Gerard; a white bicycle in profile every few metres, between the planted beds
Escòcia crossing the Meridiana: cars wait at the stop line while the other street has green
A few seconds later the lights have turned and the queue moves off
Gerard standing in a lane of the east carriageway: the cars and scooters brake and wait behind him
The avenue from above with its traffic, Fabra i Puig to Hipercor
Daylight on Passatge Maresme: neutral sun, blue-tinted shade instead of the old sepia
